# Contributing

We accept contributions via pull requests.

## AI Coding Assistants

Using AI agents to help write your PR is acceptable, but you remain responsible
for every line you submit.

When talking with maintainers, please refrain from using AI agents to generate
responses; we want to hear from you.

AI agents **must not** add `Signed-off-by` or `Co-authored-by` lines to commit
messages. Only a person can certify the DCO.

You should disclose AI use in the description of your PR and in each commit
message with an `Assisted-by: AGENT/MODEL` trailer.

An example commit message:

```text
Fix flaky reconcile test

Signed-off-by: Ada Example <ada@example.com>
Assisted-by: someagent/model-9
```

## Developer Certificate of Origin

By contributing you agree to the Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO). Every
commit needs a `Signed-off-by` line; use `git commit -s`.
